editorialSummary.heading: Fall break, winter return and early-release days
paragraphs: The regular school year for students began Wednesday, August 12, 2026. The district closed schools for severe weather Friday, October 9, and reopened Monday, October 12. Fall break came the following week: no classes Friday, October 16, or Monday, October 19, making a four-day weekend. Classes resumed October 20.

Thanksgiving break runs November 23–27, 2026. The district's Christmas Break is December 21–31. Students also have no classes on January 1, 2027 (New Year's Day), January 4 (teacher workday) or January 5 (teacher in-service day). Classes resume Wednesday, January 6, for the second semester.
Spring break runs March 22–26, 2027, with classes scheduled to resume Monday, March 29. Monday, April 12, is a separate teacher in-service day with no classes for students.

Five dates have early release: October 15, November 11 and December 18, 2026, plus March 19 and May 26, 2027. Veterans Day, November 11, remains a school day. May 26 is also the last student day and the end of the fourth grading period and second semester. The district calendar does not list dismissal times, so check with your school for bus and pickup details.

faqs.question: When does school start in Jackson County, Florida, in 2026?
faqs.answer: The first day of school is Wednesday, August 12, 2026, for students following the district's regular instructional calendar.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school in Jackson County, Florida, in 2027?
faqs.answer: Wednesday, May 26, 2027, is the last scheduled student day. Students have early release that day, which also marks the end of the fourth grading period and second semester.

faqs.question: When is fall break for Jackson County schools in 2026?
faqs.answer: Fall break is Friday, October 16, and Monday, October 19, 2026. With the weekend in between, students have four consecutive days without classes. October 15 is an early-release school day, and classes resumed Tuesday, October 20.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break for Jackson County schools in 2026?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving break runs Monday, November 23, through Friday, November 27, 2026. Including the weekends, students have November 21–29 off and are scheduled to return Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is winter break for Jackson County schools in 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: The district officially lists December 21–31, 2026, as Christmas Break. Students also have January 1 off for New Year's Day and January 4–5 off for staff work and training. Including weekends, there are no regular classes from December 19 through January 5. Students return Wednesday, January 6, 2027.

faqs.question: When is spring break for Jackson County schools in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring break is March 22–26, 2027. Friday, March 19, is an early-release school day, and classes are scheduled to resume Monday, March 29.

faqs.question: What are the early-release dates for Jackson County schools in 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: The five early-release dates are October 15, November 11 and December 18, 2026, and March 19 and May 26, 2027. Students attend school on all five dates. The annual calendar does not specify dismissal times, so check with your school for pickup and transportation details.

faqs.question: When do Jackson County students have no school for teacher workdays or in-service days?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes on January 4, January 5 and April 12, 2027. January 4 is a teacher workday, while January 5 and April 12 are teacher in-service days. The April date is separate from spring break.

faqs.question: Is there school on Veterans Day in Jackson County, Florida, in 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes. Wednesday, November 11, 2026, is an early-release school day, not a full-day holiday. Students attend classes but are dismissed early.

faqs.question: Is there a make-up day for Jackson County's October 9, 2026, closure?
faqs.answer: Schools closed Friday, October 9, because of severe weather and resumed regular schedules Monday, October 12. The district's October 7 closure and October 11 reopening announcements did not specify a make-up date. Check the district's latest announcements for changes.

about.dataSource: The supplied one-page 2026-2027 Instructional Calendar matches the complete current official PDF byte for byte. Its printed Board approval is January 20, 2026. The full calendar text and color page were reviewed, together with the district’s later October closure, reopening and fall-break notices.
about.processing: Yellow grid cells are instructional days, red cells are early release, blue and pink are staff in-service/work days, and pale green marks no school. Gold paid holidays do not imply student attendance: Labor Day, New Year’s Day, MLK Day and Presidents Day have explicit no-school captions. Fall Break is printed as October 16, 19; the event’s October 16–19 continuous span is derived only by including the intervening weekend, with no additional weekday removed. Thanksgiving is November 23–27, Christmas Break is December 21–31, and Spring Break is March 22–26. January 1, January 4 and January 5 remain separate canonical closures. The January 6 return and second-semester start are combined in one event. October 12 and March 15 are grading-period ends without early release; December 18 and May 26 retain all their same-day academic and dismissal meanings. Exclude August 5–11 pre-service, both FTE reporting weeks and May 27–28 post-year teacher workdays. The January PDF supports 178 attendance days from semester totals 85 + 93, quarter totals 43 + 42 + 47 + 46, and 206 weekdays minus 28 closures. Add the separately announced October 9 closure for the current listed-date calculation of 177. Preserve the original printed totals as original-calendar figures, without inventing a replacement date or changing the October 12 grading boundary. PDF metadata modification on January 29 is not a printed revision date. No annual dismissal clock times, report-card issue dates, graduation dates or make-up activation order are supplied.
